description: Curve Finance gauges on one chain (default Ethereum): CRV emission APR range, CRV inflation rate per second and working supply per gauge, with the pool name and addresses. Sorted by CRV APR, top 1 to 50. Relative gauge weights and bribe yields are not in this source and are not reported. Small pools can show very high APR. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: Curve blockchainId, e.g. ethereum, arbitrum (default ethereum)
